title: Python: DTN S-flag HBH option (0x03) ingress parity
description: Consumer follow-up from vectors bead 7mgm, python side: python/src/lichen/routing/router.py has DTN buffering (MAX_DTN_TTL_SECONDS, dtn_buffer) but no IPv6 hop-by-hop Type=0x03 DTN option parsing (S-flag 0x80 + absolute expiry u32 BE, spec/05-routing.md 9.8). Implement per test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (dtn_hbh cases) with the R-05-080 clockless fail-open rule, consuming the vectors in a python test. C reference: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c IPV6_HBH_OPT_DTN path.
